title: Expected fixed-shell mass forces quartic Wick scale

expected_lift.law: Let nu_N be any probability law on real degree-N cutoff fields; write H_N for fixed-ratio shell mass of sgn(f_N) and delta_N=int(f_N^2-1)^2
expected_lift.pointwise_input: K1554 gives delta_N>=c_(alpha,eta)>0 on {H_N>=eta/2}, uniformly in N
expected_lift.expected_gap: Therefore E_nu delta_N>=c'_(alpha,eta)>0 for every law with nonvanishing expected fixed-ratio sign-shell mass
expected_lift.wick_scale: For h_N=sqrt(3C_N)f_N, E_nu W_N=9C_N^2 E_nu delta_N=Omega_(alpha,eta)(N^4) when C_N=Theta(N^2)
expected_lift.localized_boundary: K1550 remains compatible because its product-Fejer bubble has both expected shell mass and defect of order N^-3 rather than a fixed positive shell expectation
expected_lift.scope_guard: The lift is distribution-free after the pointwise theorem but still requires expected fixed-ratio shell mass; it is not a Fisher/capacity estimate or a statement about arbitrary nonconstant signs
